title: Product Owner gate dependency recovery and live deployment repair
objective: Repair the live-acceptance blockers discovered at the authoritative Product Owner gate without bypassing Product Owner authority: restore a deployable Keycloak-backed confirmation boundary, wire the existing Product Owner decision consumer into the production lifecycle, and add a strictly controlled audited recovery path for failure of the confirmation dependency itself.
requirements: Preserve the authoritative WAITING_FOR_PRODUCT_OWNER hard gate; do not mark the task DONE or synthesize ACCEPT.

Implement a narrowly scoped, fail-closed, auditable Product Owner REQUEST_REWORK recovery mechanism for the case where the confirmation dependency itself is unavailable. It must require explicit Product Owner authorization, bind to task AIDP-INFRA-0002 and expected HEAD 091afb0025b2386e97d50daa5acd2913749adc1e, be single-use/idempotent, and never authorize ACCEPT.
Wire ProductOwnerDecisionConsumer/Product Owner acceptance consumption into the production watcher/lifecycle composition so recorded authenticated decisions are actually consumed.
Pin an explicit supported Keycloak container version for the governed deployment/acceptance path; do not depend on quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:latest.

Make keycloak-realm.template.json importable by the pinned Keycloak version while preserving the dedicated Product Owner browser flow, username/password plus TOTP MFA, confidential client, PKCE S256, Product Owner role, and required authorization/ACR policy.
Add an executable Docker integration/smoke test that imports the actual realm into the pinned Keycloak image and fails on import/startup failure. Unit tests that only parse JSON are insufficient.
Keep protected secrets outside Git/worktrees and retain current-user DPAPI, ACL, loopback, TLS and audit protections.
Document the exact pinned Keycloak version and live acceptance procedure.
The live failure observed during acceptance was: Unrecognized field acrToLoAMapping in RealmRepresentation. Treat this as a required regression case.
After implementation, run focused Product Owner deployment/confirmation/OIDC/HTTP/acceptance/lifecycle tests, git diff --check, and the real Docker Keycloak import smoke test.
acceptance: No governance bypass: WAITING_FOR_PRODUCT_OWNER remains authoritative until a valid ACCEPT or explicitly authorized REQUEST_REWORK is consumed.
A dependency-failure recovery can only produce REQUEST_REWORK, never ACCEPT or DONE.
Production lifecycle composition consumes recorded Product Owner decisions.
Pinned Keycloak starts and imports the shipped realm successfully in an executable smoke test.
Password plus TOTP flow and existing security controls remain enforced.
All focused tests and git diff --check pass.

product_owner_authorization.scope: rework contract creation only; no ACCEPT, DONE, merge, or gate bypass authority
